definition: In machine learning, ensemble averaging is the process of creating multiple models (typically artificial neural networks) and combining them to produce a desired output, as opposed to creating just one model.
details: Ensembles of models often outperform individual models, as the various errors of the ensemble constituents "average out".
story: Think of a historian sorting through boxes of letters, building a picture of an era one sentence at a time. Every machine is shaped by what it was shown, so someone has to choose that material with care. The examples a machine reads become the world it believes in. The words a model reads become the world it believes in. That care with the raw material is Ensemble averaging (machine learning).
